page: Miscellaneous information about contributing to Hono, sponsoring authors, and project resources. Contribution methods: issues, pull requests, third-party middleware, sharing on blogs/social media, building with Hono. Contribution Guide: github.com/honojs/hono/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md. Sponsors: @yusukebe and @usualoma via GitHub Sponsors. Resources: GitHub at github.com/honojs, npm package hono, JSR at jsr.io/@hono/hono. Questions: How do I contribute to Hono?
